findings.summary: Duplicate Slack binding enforcement can false-green beyond the capped providerConnections scan.
findings.details: The task requires one verified Slack team/app/bot binding per agency boundary, and tests cover a duplicate only in a tiny in-memory fixture. The implementation reads providerConnections through by_connection_key without equality constraints and takes 10000 rows before filtering active Slack bindings in application code. A deployment with more rows can miss an existing duplicate outside that page, so the proof lacks an exact indexed duplicate-path test and the invariant is not maintainably enforced.
